newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle active $62, off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle active $62, off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower.
Confirmed - 32,700 Last week - None Year Ago - None
WK to date - 58,300 Last week - None Year Ago - 1,200
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 62.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 62.00.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 20,300 slaughter steers and 12,500 heifers; 58,300 head confirmed for week to date which includes 25,600 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
